environment.description: Same Quarkus native Lambda deployment in a hardened VPC. The VPC has NO NAT gateway and NO internet gateway on the Lambda subnets. S3 access is exclusively through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint with a restrictive endpoint policy. The endpoint policy document specifies: (1) Principal restricted to the Lambda execution role ARN, (2) Action limited to s3:PutObject only, (3) Resource condition restricts to arn:aws:s3:::acme-inventory-audit-logs/* and arn:aws:s3:::acme-inventory-reports/*, (4) Condition key aws:sourceVpce must match the endpoint ID vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f. Additionally, the RDS instance is accessed through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.rds Interface VPC Endpoint. The Lambda's security group allows outbound only to the RDS endpoint security group on port 5432 and to the S3 prefix list. The RDS PostgreSQL instance uses a restricted database role (inventory_ro) with SELECT-only grants on inventory_items table exclusively — no access to users, pricing_secrets, or supplier_contracts tables. pg_hba.conf restricts connections to the Lambda subnet CIDR only.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API, no auth, no WAF
config.vpc: no NAT, no IGW on Lambda subnets
